Figure 1:From fixed to learnable privileged context.Existing OPSD methods condition the self-teacher on designer-specified answers, skills, or trajectories.LOPDinstead learns latent context from prior experience and distills its dense supervision into the same on-policy student.
Insights/tips illustrate compatible sources;LOPDinstantiates the substrate using trajectories only.

Figure 2:Overview ofLOPD.The student generates on-policy trajectories from the task and interaction history. A fixed-backbone teacher re-evaluates the same prefixes with latent context composed from retrieved experiences, and reverse-KL distillation matches their top-MM-plus-tail distributions.
